head: Round pressure hull inside the armor.
text: The old hull was a flat-walled octagon holding air. The crew spaces are now a round cylinder with domed ends, and the octagon is only spaced armor plates bolted to frames around it.

head: A shadow shield that could be built.
text: The three-metre solid slab became a thin tungsten and lithium-hydride plate on a rib frame. The thrust struts pass through sleeves in it to a thrust frame on the hull.

head: The drum is one pressure vessel.
text: It is a single hull with rounded ends under spaced rim plates on hoop frames, and it turns between the fixed collars as its own part. Bearing rings, hazard bands and the ship's name were added.

head: Coilguns made of coils.
text: The square beam barrels are now bore tubes carrying fifteen drive coils in a stringer cage with bus bars on top. Each turret has a barbette, rangefinder arms, recoil cylinders and armored capacitor banks.

head: Radiators that fold.
text: The thick radiator slabs became thin segmented strips on hinge booms, held flat by king posts and stay rods, and they come out of bays with open doors. The hot set keeps its stepped edge inside the shield's shadow.

head: Tanks, boat and torches rebuilt.
text: The water tanks have domed ends, cradles and armor shells. The rescue boat is a round-hulled capsule, and each torch now has coil cryostats, a throat shroud with a water-injection ring, beam injectors and a strut cage.
